steps.title: Bring in the spreadsheet.
steps.body: Ingredients, prices, recipes and menu from the finance workbook. It proposes recipes; you confirm them. 23 recipe proposals waiting.

steps.title: Add shelf lives for fresh stock.
steps.body: Not in the workbook. Without them, orders can't be capped to what will keep. 100 are still guesses.

steps.title: Confirm supplier terms.
steps.body: Delivery days, cut-offs, minimums and fees. 6 are still guesses.

steps.title: Connect Lightspeed.
steps.body: So sales come in by themselves and stock is worked out from them. Connecting is done on the server, not here.
steps.cli_fix: Set CAFEOPS_LIGHTSPEED_CLIENT_ID, CAFEOPS_LIGHTSPEED_CLIENT_SECRET, CAFEOPS_LIGHTSPEED_REFRESH_TOKEN, CAFEOPS_LIGHTSPEED_BUSINESS_ID in .env

steps.title: Do a first count.
steps.body: Tier A first. Every estimate starts from a real count. 11 of 11 tier A counted.

warnings.name: seasons
warnings.detail: 1 of 2 season(s) drive nothing: Pumpkin season. Seasonality is resolved through variant options, so an ingredient reached only by a manual recipe is never treated as seasonal -- its sales stay in the ordinary 28-day baseline and its orders are not capped at the window (spec 4.3). The effect shows up a season LATER, as a forecast inflated by a line that is no longer on the menu
warnings.fix: confirm the detected templates -- `cafeops proposals` lists them, and the Import review screen confirms one. Materialising a template is what turns its flavour options into variant options the season rules can see

warnings.name: credentials
warnings.detail: this check could not run: TypeError: _check_credentials() missing 1 required positional argument: 'r'
warnings.fix: the finding is the crash itself -- the other checks below still apply

warnings.name: takings
warnings.detail: no payment days recorded, so nothing knows what the cafe took. Money & P&L can show what is being SPENT and what was wasted, but not contribution
warnings.fix: export a payment report from the back office and run `cafeops payments import --commit`, or point CAFEOPS_PAYMENTS_CSV_DIR at it

warnings.name: prices
warnings.detail: 42 current price(s) are ESTIMATE. They stay flagged through every rollup and are excluded from margin aggregates, so nothing is being presented as more certain than it is
warnings.fix: `cafeops set-price --ingredient <name> --pack-cost <pence> --commit` replaces one with an invoiced price and cascades it to every menu cost
